title: Update portfolio headshot assets and cache-busting

requirements.summary: Replace generated portfolio headshot PNG assets with square-cropped versions derived from the newly uploaded image, preserving existing filenames and dimensions.
acceptanceCriteria: The file "frontend/public/assets/generated/portfolio-headshot.dim_512x512.png" is updated to the new uploaded photo (square crop) and remains 512x512 PNG.
The file "frontend/public/assets/generated/portfolio-headshot-large.dim_1280x1280.png" is updated to the new uploaded photo (square crop) and remains 1280x1280 PNG.
HeroSection displays the updated photo in the circular headshot area using the existing HEADSHOT_512 path.
The HeadshotLightbox displays the updated photo using the existing HEADSHOT_1280 path.

file_operations.description: Overwrite this static asset with a square-cropped PNG derived from the uploaded source image "Profile picture (2)-4.png", ensuring output remains exactly 512x512 and PNG.
Overwrite this static asset with a square-cropped PNG derived from the uploaded source image "Profile picture (2)-4.png", ensuring output remains exactly 1280x1280 and PNG.

requirements.summary: Increment HEADSHOT_VERSION to change HEADSHOT_512/HEADSHOT_1280 query strings for cache-busting while keeping filenames unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: "frontend/src/content/assetPaths.ts" HEADSHOT_VERSION is increased from its current value so the resulting HEADSHOT_512/HEADSHOT_1280 strings differ from the previous build.
After a hard refresh, the site loads the new headshot without showing the previous/cached image.

file_operations.description: Increment the HEADSHOT_VERSION constant so HEADSHOT_512 and HEADSHOT_1280 produce new query-string URLs without changing the underlying image filenames.

requirements.summary: Ensure all headshot renders in the portfolio UI use centralized HEADSHOT_512/HEADSHOT_1280 constants instead of hard-coded headshot paths.
acceptanceCriteria: No portfolio components reference "/assets/generated/portfolio-headshot" via hard-coded strings; they use HEADSHOT_512 / HEADSHOT_1280 instead.
All headshot renders update automatically when HEADSHOT_VERSION changes.

file_operations.description: Audit and update (if needed) the headshot image and lightbox trigger to ensure they exclusively reference HEADSHOT_512 and HEADSHOT_1280 imported from frontend/src/content/assetPaths.ts (no hard-coded headshot strings).
Audit and update (if needed) to ensure the lightbox never hard-codes any headshot path and relies solely on the imageSrc prop supplied by callers using HEADSHOT_1280.
